title: Contains Duplicate II
statement: Return true when two distinct indices i and j exist with nums[i] == nums[j] and abs(i - j) <= k.
hints: Store the last index of each value.
When the value repeats, compare the distance with k.
A sliding set of the last k elements also works: the window never needs to remember older indices.

approaches.name: All pairs
approaches.explanation: For each index look back k steps.

approaches.name: Last index map
approaches.explanation: Compare the current index with the previous index of the same value.

editorial: A dictionary from value to the latest index answers the distance test in expected constant time. Update the index after the test so the next duplicate sees the closest previous occurrence. If k is 0, no distinct pair can satisfy the distance, and the map still returns false.
